examples.prompt: Match each treated-water storage or clearwell feature to its operational role.

pairs.right: Buffers distribution demand while keeping filtration flow steady
Balances supply and high demand while supporting system pressure
Allows one cell to remain operational when the other is isolated
Admits air as water is withdrawn to reduce vacuum development

examples.explanation: Constant-rate filters rely on clearwells to absorb demand swings, finished-water storage balances supply and pressure, two-cell reservoirs allow one cell to stay online during isolation, and tank vents prevent vacuum during withdrawal.

examples.prompt: Match each power, energy, or efficiency concept to its definition in operator math.

pairs.right: Measures the amount of work performed per unit time
Measures energy used by a power load over elapsed hours

Divides the percentage value by one hundred

examples.explanation: Power is work performed per unit time, a kilowatt-hour measures energy used over elapsed hours, wire-to-water efficiency multiplies motor and pump efficiencies, and converting a percent to a decimal divides by 100.
